text:
perf-ci-bot: nightly candidate-kernel sweep completed. 12 candidates exercised across Ampere/H100/A100. One regression flagged: ampere longseq path p99 +28% when autotune selected 'matmul_v3_opt'. Summary and artifacts: http://internal/perf/3802469123 :rotating_light:

anya: saw the alert. can someone paste the flamegraphs and microbench outputs? is this the autotune pick for ampere longseq? :eyes:

sahil: yes — autopick chose matmul_v3_opt for ampere when sequence >= 2k under the midseq heuristic. KV cache miss rate also ticked up about 12% in the perf report. attaching quick microbench output below.

lee: reproducing locally now (running bench against a node in perf-lab). command i'm using:
```
./krnl-bench --kernel matmul_v3_opt --arch ampere --seq 3072 --batch-size 16 --iters 500 --warmup 50
```

sahil: here's the microbench excerpt from the nightly runner:
```
ARCH: ampere    KERNEL: matmul_v3_opt
SEQ: 3072   BATCH:16
avg latency per token: 1.28ms   p99: 3.02ms   throughput toks/s: 24500
previous best (matmul_v2): p99 2.34ms   throughput 30500  
metric: kv_cache.hit_rate  -> 0.78 (was 0.89)
metric: memcpy_time_ms -> +42% vs baseline
```

mike: flamegraph points to hotspots in kv_cache::lookup and dispatch::copy_kv (large stacks in the matmul edge path). looks like extra copies or alignment shims introduced in the asm shim.

anya: that smells like an ABI/align change in the kernel. does git blame show any recent asm tweaks? sahil, can you check kernel PRs merged in the last two commits?

sahil: checked — commit ae1234f changed vector tail-handling in matmul_v3 and a follow-up 9f2b77 adjusted memory strides. bisect on harness narrowed regression to commit ae1234f.

lee: started a targeted candidate CI with KV_TRACING=1 and extra memcpy timers. ETA ~45m.

perf-ci-bot: scheduled rerun with KV instrumentation and expanded seq buckets [512,1024,2048,3072,4096]. results will post to the same artifact page when done.

mike: quick thought — if the kernel's prefetch or alignment now forces an extra buffer copy for unaligned KV entries, that explains both increased memcpy_time and reduced hit-rate (since copy path delays allow timeouts on some cache entries).

anya: plan for triage: 1) confirm repro on perf-lab (lee) 2) isolate asm diff and try a minimal revert test (sahil) 3) prepare a rollout gate to disable matmul_v3 for ampere longseq if confirmed (mike).

sahil: I'll prepare a revert-try PR with a microbench job matrix (seq x batch) so we can validate across distribution. matrix will include seq=[512,1024,2048,3072,4096] batch=[8,16,32].

lee: rerun finished — key numbers: KV misses increased ~13%, dispatch copy time +40% in the matmul path on Ampere. H100 runs unaffected (H100 picks a different kernel variant). Artifact: /artifacts/perf/3802469123/flamegraphs.tar.gz

perf-ci-bot: rerun summary: regression reproduced. bisect points to ae1234f. additional note: autotuner weight for 'midseq' heuristic favors matmul_v3_opt for >2k seq; fallback logic did not trigger since throughput baseline was slightly higher in microbench without KV instrumentation.

mike: given this, recommend gating matmul_v3 in the rollout config for arch=ampere & seq>=2048 until we revert or patch. I'll draft the rollout change.

anya: agreed. sahil, can you open the hotfix PR to revert ae1234f and include the microbench matrix + flamegraphs? set PR label perf/regression and request @anya @mike for review. also add a note to autotune to prefer KV-hit-preserving kernels for longseq.

sahil: will do. drafting now, ETA 1hr. PR will include instructions to run the local repro command and a short checklist for reviewers.

lee: uploaded debug traces and the raw perf counter logs to /artifacts/3802469123/debug/ (kv_trace.json, memcpy_samples.log).

anya: thanks — let's sync in the eng-runtime standup in 30m to confirm rollout. good job catching this quickly. :thumbsup:

mike: one more follow-up: add a microprobe that exercises unaligned KV entries to the nightly harness so we detect similar regressions earlier. filing a small task in backlog.

perf-ci-bot: follow-ups created: TASK-1182 (add unaligned-kv microprobe), PR-4521 (revert ae1234f), ROLLOUT-333 (gate matmul_v3 on ampere longseq).
